spanish: E hicieron sobre el pectoral cadenas trenzadas, obra de cordón, oro puro.

findings.issue: שַׁרְשְׁרֹת is a feminine plural construct and גַּבְלֻת is a feminine singular absolute noun; Spanish turns that noun into the plural adjective trenzadas. The twisted sense remains.

notes: The rest matches the tokens: 3mp qal made, upon the singular breastpiece, cord-work, pure gold.
